findings.evidence: Target moved saveSeenIds(userId, seenIds) from after ensurePermission() (Base) to before it (lines 72-75). ensurePermission() awaits isPermissionGranted()/requestPermission(), which are Tauri IPC calls and can reject; the outer try/catch then returns 0 with the fresh ids already recorded as seen.
findings.impact: A transient IPC failure while checking permission silently drops that batch of OS notifications: the ids are already seen, so later polls never retry them (Base retried on the next poll). The in-app inbox still shows them, so only the desktop toast is lost. Permission denied (not an exception) behaves as before.
findings.recommendation: Optional follow-up: on an exception from ensurePermission(), restore the previous seen set (or save only after a granted/denied answer). The concurrency guard (pendingByUser) already prevents duplicates, so saving after permission no longer risks double toasts. Not blocking for merge.
